fmt: told in first person by someone who lived through it ('that night I...'), as if sharing a true experience
title: রাজস্থানের সেই অভিশপ্ত বাওলি 🪔
summary: Travel photographer Subir and his skeptical friend Rohan venture into an abandoned eighth-century Rajasthani stepwell at night, defying local warnings that forbid descending past sunset. Legend warns that the stepwell has exactly eighty-four steps, and counting beyond that traps the intruder in a spirit maze ruled by a vengeful medieval queen. While retrieving a dropped camera lens, Rohan playfully counts eighty-five steps, instantly triggering a terrifying shift where the top exit disappears and the stairs expand into an impossible labyrinth. In the pitch darkness, a shadowy entity in royal red attire begins stalking them from the stagnant black water below, whispering Rohan's name. Part 1 ends as a cold hand grabs Rohan's ankle dragging him toward the abyss, while the spirit manifests above on the only staircase leading out.
part2_plan: Part 2 reveals the tragic history of Rani Padmavati who sacrificed her maidservants inside the baori during a medieval siege, cursing the reservoir to feed on curious trespassers. Subir fights the supernatural gravity of the well using an ancient copper locket he discovered earlier, racing against time as Rohan's consciousness slips away into the spirit realm. A shocking twist unveils that the local guide who warned them outside was actually the guardian spirit's harbinger who lured them to their doom. Subir must make an impossible sacrifice of his sight or memories to break the curse and escape the desert stepwell before the first light of dawn seals them inside stone forever.

characters.name: Subir
characters.look: Twenty-six-year-old Bengali youth with disheveled black hair, olive safari jacket over grey t-shirt, DSLR camera strap around neck, wide fearful eyes, clutching a brass torch.

characters.name: Rohan
characters.look: Twenty-seven-year-old tall Bengali guy in dark maroon hoodie, rimmed spectacles, jeans, carrying a high-beam flashlight, visibly trembling hands and pale skin.

characters.name: Chhaya
characters.look: Ancient gaunt desert spirit in dusty, faded crimson Rajput lehenga, tarnished silver ornaments, long matted coal-black hair covering half her pale cracked face, feet hovering inches above stone stairs.

setting: An ancient eighth-century sandstone stepwell (baori) deep in the Thar desert of Rajasthan. Symmetrical zigzagging stone staircases plunge seventy feet down into pitch-black, stagnant water. Intricate Rajput stone jharokhas, carved pillars with eroded faces, dry desert wind, cold blue moonlight filtering from the open square sky above.

choice.question: সুধীর এখন কী করবে?
choice.plan1: If Subir dives into the icy black water, he discovers an underwater tunnel containing ancient skeletal remains and must battle the watery apparition directly with fire to pull Rohan ashore.
choice.plan2: If Subir dashes upward toward the ghost blocking the archway, he confronts the spirit face-to-face, uncovering a hidden temple niche where an ancient warding mantra is inscribed on stone.
